name: pointer-capture-outside-down-up-failure
description: a `capture` action after the sequence's pointer has already lifted fails with a fixed detail, the same way an out-of-bracket `wait` or `move` would
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: pointer capture outside bracket
env: {}
---
- launchApp
- pointer:
    touches:
      - actions:
          - down:
              x: 10
              y: 10
          - up
          - capture
          - up
